description: This Java interface defines a factory for creating Kafka publisher actors within the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies methods to retrieve actor names and create actor properties based on connection configurations.

classes.name: KafkaPublisherActorFactory
classes.description: Interface for a factory that creates Kafka publisher actor instances, providing methods to obtain actor names and actor configuration properties.

methods.name: getActorName
methods.description: Returns the name that should be used for the actor created by this factory.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns the Props object for instantiating a Kafka publisher actor, configured with a specific connection, connection factory, and mode (dry-run or real).
